@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in this channel. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the channel shows the guard was **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard**, which you noted at 10:42. At 11:03 Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and said the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You then posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
